items.acceptance: Ubuntu 24.04 cloud cutover verified at 20:20 Asia/Shanghai, release c5187ef. Four healthy services, six timers, 20 stable table fingerprints and model settings match, verified public HTTPS and restricted read-only monitoring. Local source stopped and retained. See LONGRUN_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

Verified real Nov13, Nov16 and Nov17 BaoStock receipts each have 5224 supported symbols. The Nov18 19:10 job recovered the Nov16 gap and refreshed Nov17. The Nov18 reference request timed out and the job remains partial. Broader history and stable availability remain open.

Verified real Nov13/16/17 unadjusted EOD status for one watched symbol per date, with raw hashes and receipt times. Broader and intraday coverage still needs a validated source. Daily approval remains manual.
Same-day band suggestions, explicit per-row human batch review, no automatic approval; source conflicts/corruption block.

Account-specific preferences drive manual or explicitly installed daily research. Supported evidence scope AI/robotics/new energy; saving preferences alone never submits research or enables trading. Semiconductors/custom/hot-event discovery not implemented.

Nov17 managed observations cover the afternoon; earlier trial receipts are separate. Nov18 morning and afternoon had 1290 and 1247 usable batches, 1 and 37 stale batches, and maximum usable-receipt gaps of 16.123 and 19.564 seconds. The archive estimates fresh-batch availability at 99.6% and 49.5%, respectively. The natural Nov18 report reconciled. More observation days and reliable intraday quality are pending. Source receipts were rechecked after cloud migration. Cloud observation starts with the next trading day and needs five complete healthy natural sessions.
Exchange-quality intraday suspension/ST/listing/relisting/corporate-action status and complete daily bands need a validated source; unknown remains human-reviewed.

Verified current Eastmoney receipts for AI, robotics and new energy. The first Nov18 evening schedule verified 731 AI and 796 robotics members; new energy failed and its earlier receipt remains available. Complete nightly and historical coverage remain open; see THEMES_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

CNinfo retains original JSON/PDF records. The Nov18 13:00 natural schedule produced 8 verified excerpts and 18:00 produced 7. The host worker now defers claims during the bounded excerpt derivation window. A scheduled real model result using an excerpt and broader industry news remain open.

User-configured deepseek-flash completed real manual and scheduled title-based requests. The first Nov18 08:30 scheduled run completed with one evidence-scoped issuer candidate and 1833 provider tokens. Candidate citations show the exact saved announcement revision and any included excerpt. The Nov18 18:57 web-only rollout followed isolated browser checks with genuine title evidence and a controlled excerpt. The first naturally scheduled real result containing an excerpt remains open. The Nov19 08:30 real run used an excerpt and reached DeepSeek. Strict prose checks rejected copied percentages and approval language. Both prompts clarified those restrictions; natural post-fix result remains pending.

Evidence-linked research, exact-version HTTPS review links and human-controlled paper strategies are on the cloud. Authentication and the exact browser target were verified in isolation. Production has no approved or active strategy. Actual user approval and card delivery remain open.

The deployed cloud worker supports one simulated buy per immutable version after explicit human approval and activation. Draft creation, approval and activation precheck the fee-inclusive cap. Submission rechecks the exact hash, reserve, available cash, fresh accepted quote and current human-reviewed rules. The Nov18 17:57 release added the exact order's status, fills, fees and reserve to version detail. Controlled cases verified partial fill, expiry and revocation. Actual user activation and a naturally triggered order remain pending.

Cloud release 554ff58 exposes an authenticated account-level template, and scoped scheduler integration. An isolated PostgreSQL end-to-end test verifies template save, exact draft, a single simulated review notice, human approval and separate enablement, one controlled paper order and fill. The real template, first natural draft, Feishu display and actual paper order are pending. The Nov19 08:30 task provided no validated result, and the production template was inactive. No draft or approval was recorded.

Read-only authenticated exact-version API and workspace view reconcile simulated orders, fills and fees. Human review suggestion requires linked post-submission wall-clock evidence. No PnL when necessary evidence is missing. Production deployment, daily digest integration, and natural result remain open. Included in cloud release 554ff58.
VectorBT/Backtrader/Optuna research with point-in-time universe, cost assumptions, holdout evaluation and human strategy promotion.
Weekly out-of-sample evaluation and human-approved weight changes; Feishu interactive approval separate from webhook.
Evaluate PR358/Laya API, license, isolation and provider-specific held-out Chinese A-share calibration; not required for paper simulation.
Ubuntu local tests do not establish Windows or GitHub CI execution; workflow credentials currently insufficient.

Webhook is configured. The durable receipt release deployed locally on Nov18 at 16:12. Both existing reports retain their original content with no observed receipt. Future natural webhook acceptance and actual group display remain open. Cloud HTTPS and signed account configuration were verified on Nov18. No extra test or historical resend was triggered. Nov19 release shows local Asia/Shanghai event times in the concise review, operation and report messages. On Nov19 at 09:04, the configured signed webhook acknowledged a genuine template setup reminder. Actual group display and a real fill receipt are pending. No receipts were found for the Nov17 fill or old daily reports. The user confirmed group display of the 09:04 setup reminder. Historical fill receipts remain absent.
Calendar verified coverage currently ends 2026-12-31; matching must remain closed outside known coverage.
No live broker connection and no automatic AI strategy promotion; not a deliverable to unlock.
Actual official settings/save returned success, private persistent runtime.env mode0600 / parent0700 nonroot UID10001, restart retained setting; no real API key/model request needed for test.

Official A-share search and identity metadata retained. Fixed common watchlist context labels hiding existing names; paper selectors and holdings show observed names or explicit missing-name labels; 37 frontend tests passed.

Newly generated daily reports format actual ledger, positions, fees and reconciliation. No fabricated mark-to-market returns, selection or strategy changes. Delivery is best-effort, no retry on unknown result.

Human-authenticated read-only theme list/detail APIs and official paper-page archive panel with provenance, missing-data state, bounded pagination and stale-request guards. No ingestion, order, preference or approval writes; see THEME_WEB_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

The first natural Nov18 evening run verified two of three configured boards. The failed new-energy request was not repeated that evening. The network-disabled SIGKILL rehearsal verified exact container cleanup and one-attempt recovery. Full coverage and host disaster recovery remain open.

One-shot scoped Feishu reminders for an approved version awaiting activation and qualifying intraday conditions awaiting human daily security review. Isolated database fixtures verified exact URLs, current evidence, receipt claiming and no retry after uncertain delivery. Genuine actions and Feishu group display remain pending. Released to the cloud in ed6f281, and the safety flags and HTTPS 5188 origin were verified.

Exact-version automatic buy/sell draft uses a fixed 60-session historical replay with 40-session holdout, data hashes, fees and settled positions. Controlled PostgreSQL rehearsals cover both sides and explicit independent approval and enable. A single real BaoStock probe timed out. Natural data, a genuine approved order and actual delivery remain to be observed. Cloud release 0a555ea verified account, UI, migration and preserved ledger. No account template was saved at verification.

Forward-only per-fill ID Feishu notices carry exact Shanghai time, side, quantity, price, notional and fee. Intent/result are durable and uncertain outcomes do not retry. Old fills and reports were not resent. Isolated tests cover both sides and daily-report coexistence.
